message.content: In December, Los Angeles typically enjoys mild winter weather. The average high is around **68 °F (20 °C)**, while the average low dips to about **48 °F (9 °C)**. Overall, the mean daily temperature hovers near **58 °F (14 °C)**. These values can vary slightly year to year, but December is generally one of the cooler months in LA, though still quite comfortable compared to many other U.S. cities.
